method: One-off pywin32 COM script (WSL2 -> Windows python.exe). New workbook; sheet 'data' A1:B1 = d,v; A2:A72 = 0..70 with NumberFormat 'yyyy/m/d'; B2:B72 = 1. For each variant a separate PivotCache (PivotCaches().Create(xlDatabase, 'data!R1C1:R72C2')) and PivotTable on its own sheet at A3; row field d, data field Sum of v. Then pt.PivotFields('d').DataRange.Cells(1).Group(Start, End=True, By=7, Periods=(F,F,F,T,F,F,F)) with Start = True (auto) / 1 / 0 / 61. Whole pt.TableRange1 read cell by cell (.Text/.Value) into table_grid; rows = body rows (label col 1, Sum col 2); PivotItems Name/Caption/Value too. Saved as .xlsx (51) and .xlsb (50) by Excel.
